parallels.note: The priests shall not eat of anything that dies of itself, or is torn, whether it is bird or animal.

translations.web: You shall not eat any blood, whether it is of bird or of animal, in any of your dwellings.
translations.bsb: You must not eat the blood of any bird or animal in any of your dwellings.
translations.kjv: Moreover ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of fowl or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
translations.asv: And ye shall eat no manner of blood, whether it be of bird or of beast, in any of your dwellings.
